#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

#define ull unsigned long long
#define FastIO ios::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(nullptr); cout.tie(nullptr);

typedef long long ll;
typedef vector<ll> vi;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pi;

bool isPrime(ull n) {
    if (n <= 1) return false;
    if (n <= 3) return true;
    if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) return false;
    for (ull i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6)
        if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0)
            return false;
    return true;
}

    ll res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % m;
        a = (a * a) % m;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll nCr(int n, int k) {
    if (k > n) return 0;
    ll res = 1;
    if (k > n - k) k = n - k;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        res *= (n - i);
        res /= (i + 1);
    }
    return res;
}

#define arrall(A, n) (A), ((A) + (n))
#define rall(A) (A).rbegin(), (A).rend()
#define sz(A) (int)(A).size()
#define pb push_back
#define ppb pop_back
#define mp make_pair

#define square(X) ((X) * (X))
#define cube(X) ((X) * (X) * (X))

#define forr(i, n) for (int i = int(n) - 1; i >= 0; --i)
#define fora(i, a, b) for (int i = int(a); i <= int(b); ++i)
#define forb(i, a, b) for (int i = int(a); i >= int(b); --i)
#define fore(it, a) for (auto it = (a).begin(); it != (a).end(); ++it)
#define deb(x) cout << '>' << #x << ':' << x << endl;

void solve() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    bool atFlag = false;
    int n = ln(s);
    cout << s[0];
    vector<bool> done(n + 1, false);
    done[0] = true;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n - 3; ++i) {
        done[i] = true;
        if (s[i] == 'a' && s[i + 1] == 't' && !atFlag) {
            cout << '@';
            atFlag = true;
            done[i + 1] = true;
            ++i;
        } else if (s[i] == 'd' && s[i + 1] == 'o' && s[i + 2] == 't' && i != n - 3) {
            cout << '.';
            done[i + 1] = true;
            done[i + 2] = true;
            i += 2;
        } else {
            cout << s[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (!done[i]) cout << s[i];
    }
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("in.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("op.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif
    FastIO;
    ll t = 1;
    //cin >> t;
    while (t--) {
        solve();
    }
}
